mapper.update: update t_user SET phone=#{phone}, name = #{name}, QQ = #{idCardNo} where userid=#{playerId}
mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM t_user WHERE agent_id=#{playerId}
select count(1) FROM ims_tpuser WHERE id=#{playerId}
SELECT id FROM t_game_type WHERE roomType=#{roomType}
SELECT roomType as mapKey, room_name as mapValue FROM t_game_type where is_show=1 group BY roomType;
SELECT * FROM t_game_type WHERE roomType=#{mapKey} and is_show=1 AND game_type_parent_id is NULL
SELECT * FROM t_game_type WHERE game_type_parent_id = #{id} and is_show=1
SELECT tg.*, tv.version FROM t_game tg left JOIN t_version tv ON tg.game_id = tv.game_id WHERE tg.game_type = #{id}
SELECT content FROM t_game_config WHERE level =#{level}
select money_repository from bullfight_gameinfo${l} where mid=#{playerId}
SELECT money_repository FROM bullfight_gameinfo${l} where mid=#{userId}
select sum(owerincome) from ims_tpgold WHERE userid=#{userId} and isower=1
SELECT sum(owerincome) FROM ims_tpgold where isower=1 and userid=#{playerId} and date_format(createtime,'%Y-%m-%d')= curdate()
SELECT player as playerId, date as date, gold_count as goldCount FROM ims_tpplayergoldreport WHERE player=#{playerId} and date_format(date,'%Y-%m')=#{date} order by date
select count(1) FROM t_player_task${l} where player_id=#{playerId} and task_id=5
select ifnull(sum(rmb_amount),0) from t_account_charge WHERE status=2 and user_id=#{playerId}
SELECT fenchang as fenchang, mis_coins_gold as misCoinsGold, is_quick_match as isQuickMatch FROM t_level_fenchang where level = #{level}
